promotion.rule: ≥10% lower MAPE than M1 at h=10 and h=20, DM p<0.05, 80% interval coverage within ±5pp

vix.method: rel = VIX-bucket fixed effect from log(activity) ~ piecewise trend (120-day knots) + regime + expiry-cycle + bucket; normalised to a day-weighted mean of 1. CIs: cluster bootstrap over consecutive-day runs.

notes: BSE revenue grew several-fold since 2023; VIX effects come from a regression with a piecewise trend, so growth is not mistaken for a VIX effect.
